description: This PHP class 'LeaveRequestCommentDecorator' is part of the OrangeHRM system, specifically within the Leave plugin's entity decorators. It provides methods to encapsulate and manipulate LeaveRequestComment entities, including setting references to employees, users, leave requests, and formatting creation dates and times.

classes.name: LeaveRequestCommentDecorator
classes.description: A decorator class for LeaveRequestComment entities, providing methods to associate related entities and format creation timestamps.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the decorator with a LeaveRequestComment entity.

methods.name: setCreatedByEmployeeByEmpNumber
methods.description: Sets the Employee who created the comment by their employee number.

methods.name: setCreatedByUserById
methods.description: Sets the User who created the comment by user ID.

methods.name: setLeaveRequestById
methods.description: Associates a LeaveRequest entity by its ID.

methods.name: getCreatedAtDate
methods.description: Returns the creation date of the comment formatted as Y-m-d.

methods.name: getCreatedAtTime
methods.description: Returns the creation time of the comment formatted as H:i.
